### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata-core`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/runtime`, touching **29** documentable anchor(s).

**21** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d1fb1fb2ddbd12a0c492bdfe1dca3cbe8190461`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **35** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d1fb1fb2ddbd12a0c492bdfe1dca3cbe8190461` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `74bdc2d446a28efae0209636c4e88da8a54225cc` — the merge of head `6256d1f001dd339abfbef1a54c54dceaf64b7199` into base `8d1fb1fb2ddbd12a0c492bdfe1dca3cbe8190461`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 74bdc2d446a28efae0209636c4e88da8a54225cc && git checkout 74bdc2d446a28efae0209636c4e88da8a54225cc
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8d1fb1fb2ddbd12a0c492bdfe1dca3cbe8190461 6256d1f001dd339abfbef1a54c54dceaf64b7199 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8d1fb1fb2ddbd12a0c492bdfe1dca3cbe8190461 && git merge --no-ff 6256d1f001dd339abfbef1a54c54dceaf64b7199

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8d1fb1fb2ddbd12a0c492bdfe1dca3cbe8190461
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 8d1fb1fb2ddbd12a0c492bdfe1dca3cbe8190461` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

- `mayReadAuthoringTrail` (`isSystem`, `studio.access`, `manage_metadata`) is asked only by `refuseNonAuthoringCaller`, at the three call sites. `mayReadPendingDrafts` and the draft switches are untouched.
- `requireCommitTrailReadCapability` (`isSystem`, `studio.access`) gates `GET /packages/:id/commits` alone. `GET /packages`, `/packages/:id` and `/export` keep `requireReadCapability`.
- No door gains a capability. The refusals keep their envelope and code; only the messages change.
- The three `sys-metadata-*` comments, the `client-sdk.mdx` comments and census row 8b are accurate to the new code.
- Narrowing in every posture is what letter A ruled (C, wall-only, was the rejected option in `6187280122`).
- `check-governed-merges --pr 23674`: NOT governed. `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` is clean.
- The ADR-0087 marker reads `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

**Item 1: the changeset's BREAKING list misses a cell this PR measured and its body names.**
- **The cell:** the commits door also refuses a caller holding `setup.access` and `manage_metadata` without `studio.access`: W3's walled organization owner, granted `manage_metadata` inside its organization.
  - The report's table: "commits: … org owner + manage_metadata (no studio.access) 200 -> 403 PERMISSION_DENIED".
  - The PR body: "**A second shape loses commits, by the ruling.**"
- **Why the shipped text is wrong:**
  - The changeset's lead line scopes every door to "a caller holding `setup.access` and neither `studio.access` nor `manage_metadata`".
  - The commits bullet only adds that "`manage_metadata` alone was refused here before and still is".
  - "Who is still admitted" ends with "platform operators and metadata authors are not affected".
  - A reader who holds `setup.access` + `manage_metadata` therefore concludes that commits still answer them, and the release text is the only part that ships.
- **Fix, changeset only** (`.changeset/23546-trail-doors-setup-access.md`):
  - The commits bullet names its own broken set: `setup.access` without `studio.access`, with or without `manage_metadata`, which never admitted this door. Name W3's shape (a walled organization owner granted `manage_metadata`): it keeps history, audit and diff, and loses commits.
  - The "not affected" sentence says which metadata authors: those holding `studio.access`, or `manage_metadata` at history, audit and diff.
  - Keep the PR body's table and Acceptance notes in step if a line there quotes the changeset.
  - No code, test or docs change. Re-run `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major` on the new head, and report their verdicts.
- **CI:** at this stamp 13 checks were still running on `bf1192ef1f`. Before you push, read the head's check-runs. If any finished red, fold its fix into this round and say so; otherwise the push re-runs them.

Everything else is unchanged.

  - The three `sys-metadata-*` object comments now say the trail doors admit `studio.access` (beside `manage_metadata` at history, audit and diff), and none admits `setup.access`.
  - The `client-sdk.mdx` comments on `diffItem` and `getAudit` match.
  - Census row 8b names both new `isSystem` reads, which `check-system-context-census` requires.

- `@objectstack/rest` `minor` and `@objectstack/runtime` `minor`, `fix(rest,runtime)!:` with a **BREAKING** line per door: an accept-set narrowing shipped as `minor` under the launch-window convention. Right.
- **ADR-0087:** `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Right: no spec key, response field, error code, stored shape or export moves, and the new predicate and gate are module-private.
  - The dev re-ran `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major` (with the PR's own event payload, level axis included) on this head: both exit 0.
- **Patch round 1** (`bf1192ef1f..82dae4a76e`, the changeset only) makes the BREAKING list complete, closing the item `6192050253` raised. Read sentence by sentence:
  - **History, audit and diff:** each names "`setup.access` and neither `studio.access` nor `manage_metadata`".
  - **Commits:** names "`setup.access` without `studio.access`, with or without `manage_metadata`", and W3's walled organization owner granted `manage_metadata`, which keeps history, audit and diff and loses commits. This matches the round-0 measurement.
  - **"Not affected":** now says which metadata authors.
  - **"What changes for you":** names the `studio.access` grant for both shapes and objectstack-ai/objectui#12475.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Consumer:** objectui's Setup catalog editors call `/history` and `/audit` from ungated buttons. After this lands, an organization admin there gets 403. The companion card objectstack-ai/objectui#12475 is filed with `Blocked-by:` #23546, as ruling `6190477105` item 3 binds. No objectui consumer of `/packages/:id/commits` was found (readings `6189071639`).
- **Cross-seat:** seat 1's #23050 slice 3 holds `registerApprovalsEndpoints` in the same file. This diff does not touch it (declaration `6190539679`). `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main` is clean at this stamp.

- **Out-of-scope findings, 「承接者:无」:**
  - `OBJECT_SCHEMA_READ_ONLY_EXEMPT_CAPABILITIES`' docblock still calls itself "the /packages read cohort" (now three of four reads);
  - hypothesis (a) falsified: the census the split moved is `check-system-context-census`, not the draft-door census.
- **Deviations:**
  - `client-sdk.mdx` was edited outside the listed surface: its comments were made false by this change.
  - `origin/main` was not merged again after five commits; none of them touches these files, and the merge-tree is clean.
